short: The name Praeventores probably has the meaning of «pre-emptive». The Praeventores were formed by Constantius II in the 40s of the 4th century during the Persian war (Amm. XVIII. 9. 3). The place of their original deployment was the Danubian provinces. According to Notitia, the Milites Praeventores were located in Ansamo and were at the disposal of the dux of the Mesia II province. Ammianus Marcellinus mentions Praeventores units at the siege of the Amida fortress. The troops standing there (which were soldiers of the thirtieth legion, the tenth - which are also called Fortenses, comites sagittarii, as well as Superventores and Praeventores) made a sortie and killed a large number of Persians while they were asleep. As we see from Ammianus' information, the legion of Praeventores was active in the East, in Singara and Amida. The auxiliary unit of Milites Praeventores from the Notitia Dignitatum also belongs to the army of the East and is under the command of the Dux of Mesia Inferior. The way of war between the Asimuntians and Attila described by Priscus explains, as best as possible, the meaning of the term Milites Praeventores: they were skirmishers, and in general they were light units capable of daring raids.
history: In the face of an increasing number of barbarian incursions, the effective defence of Rome’s now-sprawling territory became a serious problem in the 4th century AD. The Emperor Constantine’s controversial solution was to divide the army into two halves. 'Limitanei', literally ‘the men on the limes’ or 'borders', were frontier garrison troops intended to pin down an invading force until the full-time 'comitatenses', the late-Roman equivalent of the traditional Legionaries, could arrive to deal with the situation decisively. Although well-equipped, limitanei were generally considered by all to be second-class warriors. This was possibly because they were often part-time soldiers who had been encouraged to settle and farm the land around their outposts in exchange for policing the Empire's borders.
strengths: Very low damage and armour penetration
